name: agent-charter
description: Decide before you build. Build from the spec. Check against the source. Agents build on every decision you hand them, so these plugins start there: they help you make better decisions, keep agents' work tied to its specs, decisions and designs, and get it checked independently before it ships.

plugins.name: decision
plugins.description: Settle what to do before you act. council: stress-test a costly decision while you can still change it. best-of-n: compare n approaches to a problem, then build the best. Agent reasoner: get an independent answer to one hard question.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Scrutinize what already exists. fresh-eyes: get an independent check that finished work is correct. risks: see what could go wrong with one plan, how likely, how bad.

plugins.name: figma-workflow
plugins.description: Figma to frontend for designers, on top of Figma's MCP server and Code Connect. plan: plan a screen from its Figma frame, new or changed. build: build the approved plan as a clickable prototype. verify: check a built screen against its Figma design.
